verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes programmatic surfaces: a published OpenAPI spec, an HTTP query interface with documented request headers, and the official clickhousectl CLI. The CLI creates and manages Cloud clusters, Postgres services, ClickPipes and other Cloud resources, which covers much of what the UI does. Nothing documents that the API matches the UI feature for feature, so the extent of parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documentation of which Cloud console actions the API covers, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only gaps don't exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed ClickHouse clusters * Create and manage ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services * Manage ClickHouse Cloud resources * Create and manage ClickPipes for data ingestion
The X-ClickHouse-Format HTTP request header now explicitly selects the format of the response
